profile.name: Weiss LabEvent气候试验箱
profile.description: 用于实验室环境应力与温控测试的气候试验箱，可读取和设定箱内温度，并控制手动模式、冷凝保护、压缩空气和空气干燥等功能。
profile.description_en: A climate chamber for laboratory environmental stress and temperature-control testing. It can read and set chamber temperature and control manual mode, condensation protection, compressed air, and air drying functions.

registry.name: Weiss Technik Weiss Lab Event
registry.description: Weiss LAB Event是由Weiss Technik生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、初始化、启动、温度设置、温度读取、状态查询。支持Signal, Slot, get air dryer等操作。
